t2firstrun.title: T2Editor initial setup
t2firstrun.subtitle: Finish setup by checking administrator access and the shared data folders.
t2firstrun.essential_body: Complete the administrator key activation, review the server support result, and then confirm this guide. The acknowledgement is stored once in the shared T2Editor data directory.
t2firstrun.step_backup: Back up the current T2Editor folder and database before changing production files.
t2firstrun.step_key: Using FTP, SSH, or SFTP, rename admin/t2admin.key.txt to admin/t2admin.key.
t2firstrun.step_admin: Open the administrator page in a new tab and create an administrator password of at least 8 characters.
t2firstrun.step_review: Review core, upload, and server support settings below, scroll to the end, and confirm.
t2firstrun.admin_warning: Do not upload a new key file. Rename the bundled file itself. Until the .txt suffix is removed, administrator functions remain disabled.
t2firstrun.powershell_command: PowerShell command for this server path
t2firstrun.shell_command: Shell command for this server path
t2firstrun.support_ok: The required runtime checks passed. Warning items may limit optional updater, marketplace, conversion, or large-upload features.
t2firstrun.support_bad: One or more required runtime checks failed. Fix the red items before normal operation.
t2firstrun.core_note: Change operational settings from the T2Editor administrator page. Keep the shared data directory private and writable by the PHP/web-server account; never use permission 777.
t2firstrun.finish_body: The confirmation button becomes available only after this guide is scrolled to the end, the acknowledgement checkbox is selected, the administrator key is active, and the shared data directory is writable. After successful confirmation this popup is never shown again for this installation.
